items.headline: Army detonates nation's stockpile of lead azide in Iowa
items.summary: After several delays, the U.S. Army has detonated a stockpile of lead azide that officials say is unsafe to move due to the risk of spontaneous explosion.

items.headline: 'Same name, same team, same week': RAGBRAI announces ownership change, start of new era
items.summary: RAGBRAI, the iconic ride across Iowa, will transition to new ownership ahead of next summer's ride, promising a new chapter for the Hawkeye State staple.

items.headline: Thanksgiving morning fire displaces 4 in Moline
items.summary: Four adults and a dog were displaced after a Thanksgiving morning house fire in Moline.

items.headline: AAA offers Tow to Go service over Thanksgiving holiday
items.summary: AAA is bringing back its Tow to Go program over Thanksgiving to help keep impaired drivers off the road both in Iowa and Nebraska.

items.headline: Man pleads guilty to straw purchase of gun used to massacre Muscatine family
items.summary: A Marion man has been convicted in connection to a Muscatine man who killed six relatives and himself earlier this year.

items.headline: USDA suspends license of a major Iowa puppy mill
items.summary: Federal regulators have suspended, for 21 days, the license of one of Iowa’s largest puppy mill operations.

items.headline: The Landing Ice Rink in Bettendorf opens Friday for third season
items.summary: The Landing Ice Rink in Bettendorf opens for its third season Friday at noon, featuring new concessions, outdoor gas fire pits, and holiday weekend hours.
